name: dsh-voice-alert
description: 让 DSH 干完活会开口说话：每个回合结束自动语音播报「完成」，出错播报「失败」，审批播报「审批」。零配置开箱即用，内置 20 个音效（提醒 10 + 大自然 10），不需要任何 Key；也可用火山「声音复刻」克隆你自己的音色念三条自定义文案。播放绝不改动系统音量或静音状态。| Make DSH speak up when the job is done: automatic voice announcements for done / failed / approval at the end of every turn. Works out of the box with 20 built-in sounds (10 alerts + 10 nature ambience) and no API key, or clone your own voice on Volcano Engine. Never touches your system volume or mute state.
